REMARKS:

020300Z POSITION NEAR 17.2N 144.7E.

02OCT26. TROPICAL STORM 26W (CHOI-WAN), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 68

NM WEST-NORTHWEST OF ANATAHAN, HAS TRACKED WEST-NORTHWESTWARD AT

04 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS.

MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 020000Z IS 992 MB. MAXIMUM

SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 020000Z IS 25 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS AT

020900Z, 021500Z, 022100Z AND 030300Z.//
